seed.premise: Caller offers guaranteed returns through a private trading group, shows fake profits, then demands a deposit to withdraw.
seed.victim: 68-year-old retired schoolteacher in Pune. Polite, deferential to authority, low tech literacy, becomes flustered quickly.
seed.style: Clipped and impatient, as if handling many cases at once.
seed.language: Indian English with occasional Tamil words (seri, illa, enna).
seed.outcome: Victim stalls and asks to call back later; scammer escalates pressure.

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Mr. Shanbhag, enna aapke number se call kar raha hoon. Kya main ishaarate ka kuch bhi batao?

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Seri... yes sir, this is me.

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Achcha, Mr. Shanbhag. Yeh aapka investment opportunity hai. Enn paise aapke pass hain, illa?

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Yes sir... I mean, no sir, I don't think so.

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Aaagye kya? Yeh genuine investment hai. Koi paise nahi chahiye, illa?

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Sir... it's just that I'm not really interested in investments right now.

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Acha, achcha. But if you join this group, enna paise ho jaayenge... 10% daily returns seri! Aapka account kya hain?

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Seri... I don't know. I'm not really sure how to use these things.

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Aapke bank ke app se sign in karo, aapka mobile number chahiye. Aaagye aapko illa?

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Sir... I'm not sure how to do that on my phone. Can we talk about something else?

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: No, this is important. Agar kuch nahi karenge illa, aapko jaldi hi problem aa jaayega. Aapke bank pass ho jayenge issues seri!

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Sir... I'm not really sure about this, can we please call back later?

seed.premise: Automated-sounding caller claims the victim's number is linked to illegal activity and will be disconnected in two hours.
seed.victim: 52-year-old homemaker in Lucknow. Defers financial decisions to her husband, which the scammer works around by demanding secrecy.
seed.style: Warm and sympathetic, positions himself as the victim's only ally.
seed.language: Mostly Indian English with Hindi discourse markers (achha, theek hai, arre).
seed.outcome: Victim grows suspicious mid-call and starts pushing back.
seed.length: 28-40 turns. Slow burn with repeated reassurance.
